messages:
sarah: Morning team — quick async standup.

sarah: Yesterday: finalized the May content calendar, queued the first batch of benchmark posts (embeddings + rerank). Noticed some noisy titles with long-tail queries.

sarah: Blockers: need eng help to add a short TTL to the benchmark endpoint (edge cache) and a bench-only embedding shape change (512 instead of 768) for the test bucket. Also opened a PR for microcopy + test assets: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/412

sarah: Today: swap microcopy, iterate on benchmark prompt set, and prep CDN canary for 14:00 PT. @mike can you confirm if the embed shape change is safe to gate behind a flag? @olivia assets uploaded (drive/redwood/bench-assets).

mike: saw the PR, will review after breakfast. Quick Q: do you want the new shape to be bench-only (namespace) or global?

sarah: bench-only please. add env var REDWOOD_EMBED_BENCH=true and default to current shape.

mike: ok will implement flag. should be non-breaking. ETA ~2h. Also propose Cache-Control: `s-maxage=60, stale-while-revalidate=300` on the benchmark endpoint to reduce spike cost. Want that?

sarah: yes please — that should help during the surge tests.

alia: heads-up: pushing the CDN canary by 30m to align with EU PMs. New target 14:30 PT. OK with eng?

ben: +1 for the delay. Also can we tag metrics from the bench run as `bench:true` so Console can show token-level cost/latency for those flows?

mike: can add a metric tag `bench:true` and a per-route tag; will include in the deploy. Need SRE sign-off on retention/limits.

olivia: uploaded two alt hero images + microcopy variants — https://drive.redwood/bench-assets. Small microcopy ask: prefer 'Generate' over 'Create' in CTAs. Attached PNG names: hero_v2.png, hero_v2_alt.png.

sarah: noted, will swap microcopy in the content calendar. thanks olivia.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: bench-service v1.12.4 — build #482 started.

mike: build green on CI. rolling canary to 10% now.

sarah: monitoring quality now, will check benchmark rerank precision and token cost. ping if any errors.

mike: seeing a small +1% p50 latency increase in the 15s window for bench requests; pausing roll to 0% to investigate.

sarah: rollback acknowledged. opened issue for infra trace: https://github.com/redwood/repo/issues/879

mike: investigating logs — looks like one path is hitting an unoptimized op when embedding length > 1024. I can add a guard to route long inputs to the v2 kernel.

sarah: good catch. if that fixes it let's re-run the bench at 13:45 PT.

mike: will update here when ready. thanks all :)
